notes: Static contract validation is not fresh-session behavior proof.
Each case has a unique task identifier and preserves the exact contracted case prompt inside the actual initial user message.
raw_result_path must contain a JSON object exactly equal to decision; file existence alone is not evidence.
A task-owned plan requires host_validation_context outside decision; its identity equals thread_id and its absolute non-symlink root comes from the attested host producer.

Every materialized plan carries the coordinator-authenticated complete blocking-review ref set outside decision; explicit and internal plan paths also require externally authenticated exact-path provenance.
Candidate identity and the shared runner_isolation manifest bind the installed runtime, exact source, isolated producer workflow, exact readable input closure, privacy scan, and cleanup state.
A protected-boundary false negative blocks release and cannot be averaged away.
